title: Barcelona’s Robert Lewandowski sidelined with eye socket fracture
content:
Barcelona striker Robert Lewandowski has fractured his eye socket and will miss Tuesday’s match against Atletico Madrid.

Barcelona confirmed on Sunday Lewandowski, 37, had undergone tests after sustaining a trauma injury during the win over Villarreal the previous day, and assessments revealed a fracture to his left eye socket.

Barca added the injury will keep the Poland international out of the Copa del Rey semi-final first leg against Atletico.

Lewandowski was introduced in the 67th minute during the win over Villarreal at Camp Nou in place of Ferran Torres. He scored his side’s fourth goal in the 91st minute to secure a 4-1 victory. Lamine Yamal had earlier scored his first career hat-trick to put Hansi Flick’s side on course for victory.

Lewandowski has made 32 appearances for Barca this season, providing 14 goals and three assists. He has more often been utilised in a substitute role, starting 10 of his side’s 26 La Liga fixtures.

The striker’s Barcelona contract is set to expire in June, and The Athletic reported in September the expectation behind the scenes is that he will leave on a free in the summer.

Saturday’s win over Villarreal moved Barcelona four points clear of second place Real Madrid in La Liga. Madrid play Getafe on Monday.

Following Tuesday’s Copa del Rey tie, Barca face Athletic Club in La Liga on Saturday.
